body:
WS1 integration review of 11c5553. The real-device evidence, device picker, granted-processing diagnostics and measurements-only report are useful and should be preserved. The ~62 ms browser estimate versus ~120 ms measured round trip directly explains the user's late-hit report.

Integration changes requested before combining with the WS1 capability:
- An armed Record is now pinned to its original target/deadline in ws1/recording-usability; remove Record from automatic revision-based re-issue when adopting that capability. Re-sending next-beat Record during a stopped count-in can alter its start. The other musical commands retain strict revision checks. See docs/RECORDING-USABILITY.md on that branch.
- MicCheck uses analysedThrough as elapsed time for its peak window. That watermark is intentionally held at the start of an open sung note, so a sustained note prevents peak eviction and stale pitch readings from aging. Use actual processed capture time for diagnostic expiry, separate from verification coverage, and add a sustained-note regression.

The current guidance to keep UI/capture changes owned by WS2 still applies. Please carry these fixes into your calibration/workspace stack and report the resulting head. This review does not establish full calibrated real-performer acceptance.

WS1 reviewed the updated lifecycle, processedThrough clock, effective-offset reporting and guided-silence fixes, then integrated the #7/#10/#11 stack in 89438d8. Combined shared checks, full Node tests, live service/WASM integration and build passed. Root Chromium checks confirmed the pitch-roll workspace and cancellation preserving timing/silence settings with synthetic input. Physical-performer validation remains open. The parent stack is integrated; this PR is retargeted to engine-integration to reflect the landed code.

WS1 reviewed and integrated the workspace stack in 89438d8 after combined checks/build and Chromium verification of no tabs, the synth piano roll, guided preparation and calibration Cancel. Follow-up for the owned consumer-wiring PR: adopt merged #12, pin the top transport while scrolling the inspector (root observed scrollY 297, header top -297/bottom -251), and keep recording state monochrome. Physical microphone/audio signoff is still open. Parent stack code is landed; this PR is retargeted to engine-integration.

WS1 review of ed57bff. The native preprocessing parity, explicit name-prior caveat, fixed prompt sets, held-out family benchmark and separation of scores from listening evidence are useful. In an isolated checkout, the base backend suite passed (113 passed / 5 skipped without built assets/model opt-ins).

One reproduced blind-kit issue to fix before merge: run(..., out=.../listening, key_dir=out/'answer-key') succeeds and writes answers.json inside the listening directory. The current check rejects only equality. Sharing the resulting listening folder would expose the key and invalidate the blind procedure. Reject keys nested anywhere under the resolved listening path (including symlink aliases) and add a regression; retain the default sibling-key behavior and overwrite protection. Reproduction used the existing research_fixtures.backend(budget=0), one piano prompt, and an isolated temporary directory; no models/API/audio capture needed.

Please also adopt merged PR #12 in a separate service-compatibility capability: Record next-beat and Clear/Undo immediate; keep the ranking PR focused. WS1 has integrated the reviewed #7/#10/#11 workspace stack, while WS2 owns the remaining epoch/reset and next-beat UI wiring. Physical listening, cross-machine kit equivalence and full hands-free acceptance remain open.
